tools.description: Look up customer information by phone number, email, or certificate number. Returns customer details and all associated certificates with deposit status and travel dates.

phone.description: Customer phone number in E.164 format (e.g., +13105551234)

tools.description: Get detailed information about a specific certificate including deposit status, travel dates, and current bookings.

certificate_number.description: Certificate number to look up (e.g., ABCD123456)

tools.description: Check if a refund has been requested for a certificate and get its current status and expected completion date.

certificate_number.description: Certificate number to check refund status for

tools.description: Check available travel dates for a specific destination. Returns list of open dates with slot availability.

destination.description: Destination to check availability for (e.g., Orlando, Las Vegas, Hawaii)

response_format.dates: array of objects with date, day_of_week, available_slots

tools.description: Book specific travel dates for a certificate. Requires certificate number, destination, and start/end dates. Returns confirmation number if successful.

certificate_number.description: Certificate number to book dates for

start_date.description: Travel start date in YYYY-MM-DD format (e.g., 2025-04-15)

end_date.description: Travel end date in YYYY-MM-DD format (e.g., 2025-04-19)

customer_lookup_by_phone.scenario: Customer calls in, AI uses their phone number to look them up automatically
customer_lookup_by_phone.use_in_node: First conversation node after greeting - lookup customer automatically using caller ID

customer_lookup_by_certificate.scenario: Customer provides certificate number during call
customer_lookup_by_certificate.use_in_node: After asking customer for certificate number - lookup their full details

check_deposit_status.scenario: Customer asks if deposit was received
check_deposit_status.use_in_node: When customer inquires about deposit - get full certificate details including payment status

check_refund.use_in_node: When customer mentions refund - check if one exists and provide status

check_availability.scenario: Customer wants to know available dates for Orlando
check_availability.use_in_node: After confirming deposit paid - check availability for their destination

book_dates.scenario: Customer selects April 15-19 for Orlando trip
book_dates.use_in_node: After customer confirms date selection - book the dates and provide confirmation

recommended_node_flow.description: Optimal node structure using all tools

flow.instruction: Automatically look up customer by phone number from caller ID
Ask customer for their certificate number
Look up customer by certificate number they provided
Now that we have their info, ask what they need help with

edges.condition: Customer wants to schedule travel dates

flow.instruction: Get full certificate details including deposit status
Tell customer their deposit status based on tool result
Check available dates for customer's destination
Present available dates to customer and ask which they prefer
Confirm booking with customer, provide confirmation number, and offer Hawaii upsell
Check refund status for customer's certificate
Explain refund status and expected timeline to customer
Present Hawaii upgrade offer (timing is perfect - customer is satisfied with resolution)
Thank customer and confirm confirmation email will be sent

important_notes: Always use tool-customer-lookup FIRST with caller ID phone number - this gives instant customer recognition
Check deposit_paid status BEFORE attempting to check calendar availability
Use tool-certificate-details for single certificate deep-dive, tool-customer-lookup for all certificates
Always confirm booking details with customer before calling tool-book-travel-dates
Offer Hawaii upsell AFTER successful booking - customer is in positive state
Handle tool errors gracefully - if lookup fails, ask for certificate number manually
Use {{dynamic.call_from_number}} to get caller ID automatically
Store tool results in conversation memory for later use in flow
